verdict.rationale: A live probe shows v0 serves a machine-readable Markdown version of its docs at https://v0.app/docs.md (HTTP 200, with frontmatter title and description), which an agent can be pointed at. However, there is no evidence of an llms.txt index, and it is unclear whether Markdown variants exist for the whole docs tree beyond the landing page. Missing for 10: an llms.txt or llms-full.txt index, documented per-page Markdown coverage across the docs, first-party documentation of agent-oriented docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming them.
